# kafka-docker-playground

> Fully automated Apache Kafka® and Confluent® Docker (and CFK) based examples, with a CLI (`playground`) to run them and to easily build reproduction models. Source code: https://github.com/vdesabou/kafka-docker-playground

The playground covers 150+ self-managed connector examples, 100+ fully-managed (Confluent Cloud) connector examples, 10+ secured environments (SASL, RBAC, SSL, mTLS...), Confluent commercial features, and multi data center deployments (Cluster Linking, Replicator, MirrorMaker 2). Examples run with any Confluent Platform version (default is CP 8.x, KRaft only) or connector version, with Docker or Podman.

Pages are Markdown files rendered with Docsify: append `.md` to a page path to get its raw source, e.g. https://kafka-docker-playground.io/how-to-use.md

## Guides

- [Introduction](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/introduction.md): features overview
- [Content](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/content.md): list of all examples (connectors, environments, ccloud, ksqlDB, multi-DC...) with versions and CI status
- [How to Use](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/how-to-use.md): prerequisites, running examples, specifying CP/connector versions, options (ksqlDB, Control Center, Grafana...)
- [CLI](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/cli.md): setup of the `playground` CLI and command reference
- [How it works](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/how-it-works.md): environments, docker compose overrides, CI
- [Reproduction toolkit](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/reusables.md): index of the pages below, and the everyday commands (status, logs, errors, waiting, containers, records, offsets)
  - [Reproduction models](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/toolkit-reproduction-models.md): building custom examples and reproduction models (`playground repro bootstrap`), sharing them as a self-contained bundle (`playground repro export` / `playground repro import`), useful functions for their scripts
  - [Producing, consuming and SMTs](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/toolkit-data.md): `playground topic produce`, `playground topic consume`, `playground connector smt test`
  - [Debugging and analysis](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/toolkit-debugging.md): remote debugging, SSL / Kerberos / class loading debug, TCP / heap / thread dumps, flight recorder, analyzing what you collected (`playground analyze`)
  - [Network](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/toolkit-network.md): network fault injection (`playground debug block-traffic`, `playground debug degrade-traffic` for latency / packet loss / corruption, `playground tcp-proxy`), HTTPS proxy
  - [Fully managed connectors](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/toolkit-fully-managed.md): service account with the least ACLs, authorization errors, Terraform (`--terraform`)
  - [Connectors and JDKs](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/toolkit-environment.md): installing other connector plugins or SMTs, specific JDKs (Azul Zulu, Oracle)
  - [Performance](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/toolkit-performance.md): `playground connector benchmark`, `--enable-sql-datagen`
- [Deep dives](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dives.md): in-depth pages on one family of `playground` commands each (mental model, internals, gotchas, hands-on lab, recipes for support repros), e.g. [network fault injection](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-network-traffic.md) with `playground debug block-traffic` / `playground debug degrade-traffic`, [test data](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-topic-produce.md) with `playground topic produce`, [reading and asserting topics](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-topic-consume.md) with `playground topic consume`, [deploying connectors](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-connector-create-or-update.md) with `playground connector create-or-update`, [troubleshooting connectors and dead letter queues](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-connector-troubleshooting.md) with `playground connector diagnose` / `playground topic dlq`, [logs](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-container-logs.md) with `playground container logs` / `playground analyze logs`, [offsets and lag](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-offsets-and-lag.md) with `playground connector show-lag` / `playground connector offsets` / `playground consumer-group`, [log levels](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-log-levels.md) with `playground debug log-level` / `playground connector log-level`, [testing SMTs](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-connector-smt-test.md) with `playground connector smt test`, [reproduction models](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-reproduction-models.md) with `playground repro`, [containers](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-container-lifecycle.md) with `playground container`, [connector plugins](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-connector-plugin.md) with `playground connector-plugin`, [Schema Registry](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-schema.md) with `playground schema`, [JVM diagnostics](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-jvm-diagnostics.md) with `playground debug` / `playground analyze`, [running examples and changing versions](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-run-and-versions.md) with `playground run` / `playground update-version`, [topic administration](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-topic-administration.md) with `playground topic`, [brokers and transactions](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-broker.md) with `playground broker` (health, broker failures, rolling restarts, stuck `read_committed` consumers), [secured environments](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-secured-environments.md) with `--environment`, [replication between clusters](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-replication.md) with the `mdc-*` environments (Replicator, MirrorMaker 2, Cluster Linking, offset translation), [Confluent for Kubernetes](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-cfk.md) with `--environment cfk` / `playground debug cfk generate-bundle` / `playground analyze logs`, [benchmarks](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-connector-benchmark.md) with `playground connector benchmark`, [fully managed connectors](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-fully-managed.md) on Confluent Cloud, [credentials and the 1Password setup](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-secrets.md) with `playground secrets`, [Oracle CDC and XStream](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-oracle-cdc.md) with `playground analyze oracle-xstream-report` / `playground connector oracle-cdc-xstream`, [debugging the JVM](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-java-debugging.md) with `playground debug enable-remote-debugging` / `java-debug` / `testssl` / `generate-diagnostics`, [a TCP proxy that breaks one connection](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-tcp-proxy.md) with `playground tcp-proxy`, [Flink SQL](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-flink.md) with `playground flink`, [AWS EC2 instances](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/deep-dive-ec2.md) with `playground ec2`
- [Salesforce examples](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/salesforce.md): set up a Salesforce org for the Salesforce examples with `playground salesforce setup` (Salesforce CLI install, External Client App with the JWT Bearer flow, Platform Event, Change Data Capture, second org for the sink examples) and check it with `playground salesforce check`
- [Academy](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/academy.md): step by step exercises on real-world connector issues
- [Claude Code](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/claude-code.md): using the repository with Claude Code (`CLAUDE.md` project guide, skills, agent-friendly CLI commands, permissions)

## CLI reference

Each command has its own page named after the command, e.g. [playground run](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/playground%20run.md), [playground connector](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/playground%20connector.md), [playground topic](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/playground%20topic.md), [playground container](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/playground%20container.md), [playground debug](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/playground%20debug.md), [playground analyze](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/playground%20analyze.md), [playground doctor](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/playground%20doctor.md), [playground repro](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/playground%20repro.md), [playground schema](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/playground%20schema.md), [playground secrets](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/playground%20secrets.md), [playground ec2](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/playground%20ec2.md). The full list is in [index.md](https://kafka-docker-playground.io/index.md).
